title: aparcstats2table
description: Converts a cortical stats file into a table format with subjects as rows and parcellations as columns.

subjectsfile.description: File containing list of subjects (one per line).
subjectsfile.title: Subjects File

qdec.description: QDEC table file with subject IDs.
qdec.title: QDEC Table

qdec_long.description: Longitudinal QDEC table with subject templates.
qdec_long.title: Longitudinal QDEC Table

hemi.description: Hemisphere being analyzed (lh or rh required).
hemi.title: Hemisphere

delimiter.description: Delimiter between measures in the table (default: tab).
delimiter.title: Delimiter

skip_missing.description: Skip subjects if input is not found.
skip_missing.title: Skip Missing Subjects

parcid_only.description: Write only ROI names without pre/appended hemi/measure.
parcid_only.title: Parcellation ID Only

common_parcs.description: Output only common parcellations across all subjects.
common_parcs.title: Common Parcellations

parcs_file.description: File specifying which parcellations to output.
parcs_file.title: Parcellations File

report_rois.description: Print ROI information for each subject.
report_rois.title: Report ROIs

etiv.description: Report volume as percent estimated total intracranial volume.
etiv.title: Estimated Total Intracranial Volume
